Have questions about Salesflow? Here are some of the most common queries to help you get started.
Have questions about solar installation, pricing, or maintenance? Our experts are ready to assist.
What solar services do you offer?
We provide solar solutions including consultation, system design, installation, and maintenance services.
How much can I save with solar panels?
Solar panels can significantly reduce electricity bills depending on system size, energy usage, and sunlight availability.
How long does solar installation take?
Most residential solar installations are completed within one to three days after system approval.
Do solar panels work during cloudy weather?
Yes, solar panels still generate electricity during cloudy days, although production may be slightly reduced.
How long do solar panels last?
Most solar panels have a lifespan of 25–30 years with minimal maintenance required.
Do you offer system maintenance and support?
Yes, we provide monitoring, maintenance services, and technical support to ensure optimal system performance.
